helpContent.intro: Here's a complete guide to get started:
helpContent.step1: Step 1: Click the File menu → Change Knowledge Base to select the folder containing your Markdown notes.
helpContent.step2: Step 2: After selecting, the app will reload. You'll see subfolders listed in the dropdown at the top.
helpContent.step3: Step 3: Choose All Folders to analyze everything, or select a specific subfolder.
helpContent.step4: Step 4: Click the Load button. The system will process your notes and build the knowledge graph.
helpContent.step5: Step 5: Once loaded, explore the graph! Double-click any node to enter Focus Mode for detailed exploration.
helpContent.tutorialLink: Want a guided tour? Launch the interactive tutorial

welcome.title: Welcome to NoteConnection!
welcome.content: This tutorial will guide you through the key features. You can skip at any time or restart from the Help menu.

kbSelection.title: Knowledge Base Selection
kbSelection.content: Use the dropdown menu here to select which folder (or subfolder) you want to analyze. Choose All Folders to include everything.

loadButton.title: Load Your Graph
loadButton.content: Once you've selected a source, click the Load button to process your notes. The system will analyze relationships and build your knowledge graph.

analysis.title: Analysis Interface
analysis.content: The Analysis Panel shows node statistics like degree centrality. Click any row to highlight that node in the graph. Perfect for identifying key concepts!

focusMode.title: Focus Mode
focusMode.content: Double-click any node to enter Focus Mode. This isolates the selected concept and its immediate connections. Use the sliders to adjust spacing. Double-click the background to exit.

controls.title: Navigation & Controls
controls.content: Use mouse wheel to zoom, click and drag to pan. The settings panel (⚙️) lets you customize physics, rendering, and visual options. Try the Freeze Layout button (❄️) to stop node movement!

quickStart.title: Quick Start Guide
quickStart.content: That covers the basics! Next, you'll see the Quick Start Guide summarizing key actions. You can access it anytime from the Help menu. Happy exploring!

manual_step1_desc: Select a folder from the dropdown (top-left) and click "Load" to visualize your notes.
manual_step2_desc:
• Pan/Zoom: Drag background to move, Scroll/Pinch to zoom.
• Inspect: Click (Mobile) or Hover (PC) a node to see connections.
manual_step3_desc: Double Click a node to enter Focus Mode. This isolates the concept and arranges its dependencies hierarchically.
manual_step4_desc:
• Freeze (❄️): Stop movement to easily click/read nodes.
• Layout: Switch between "Force" (Cluster) and "DAG" (Tree) layouts in the side panel.
